description: Left Princeton to join Y Combinator for [Coevolved](https://coevolved.ai).

Started Vytal with friends, an early [medtech team that raised $1.2M](https://www.forbes.com/sites/craigsmith/2023/09/05/teens-launch-125m-eye-scan-startup-to-detect-dementia/).
Deep Learning Research at George Mason University focused on continual learning.
Medaled at National and Virginia Science Olympiad competitions.
